name: Custom Elements
project_description: The Custom Elements module provides the framework for rendering Drupal data (entities, fields, ...) into custom elements markup. Custom elements can be easily rendered by frontend components, e.g. via web components or various Javascript frontend frameworks. This enables Drupal to render into high-level theme components, while the actual rendering of the components is handled by a frontend application (possibly in the browser). The module provides the UI to configure custom element output for entities by view-mode (3.x), the API to build a nested tree of custom element objects with associated cache metadata, the API to serialize that tree into markup or a JSON representation, and the API for other modules to customize rendering via custom element processors and field formatter plugins. It is the core of Lupus Decoupled Drupal and integrates with Layout Builder, the Canvas module (experimental), and the Thunder distribution.
